tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Look up one European company by country and national company number. Returns name, status, legal form, registration date, address, industry codes, VAT/tax IDs where available and filed financials where available. Countries: Sweden, Norway, Finland, France, UK, Ireland, Czechia, Poland, Estonia, Latv

tools.name: get_company_financials
tools.description: Key filed financials for one company (revenue, profit, assets, equity and similar where the company files them), plus name, status and the accounts date. Best coverage: Sweden, Norway, Finland, France, Estonia; UK returns accounts category and dates. Returns financials: null (with a neutral reason c

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find companies by name and get their national numbers (then call get_company). Available for Finland, Ireland, Czechia, Latvia, Switzerland, Slovenia and Cyprus. For the UK and Sweden use find_companies (industry, city, financials). Starter keys return a short sample (up to 5 matches); paid keys all

tools.name: find_companies
tools.description: Search companies in the UK or Sweden with combined filters: industry (SIC/NACE code or a word like plumber), city or region, status, incorporation date range, and (UK only) revenue, profit, equity or employee ranges. Sweden also supports hiring=true to keep only employers with recent public job ads.

tools.name: search_eu_tenders
tools.description: Search public tenders and contract awards published across the EU/EEA and Switzerland: title, buyer, country, CPV classification, deadline, estimated or awarded value and winners for awards. Filter by keyword, buyer countries, days back and type. Starter keys return a short sample (up to 5 results,

tools.name: search_uk_tenders
tools.description: Search UK public-sector tenders and awarded contracts, including winning suppliers (use status=awarded for contract winners, then get_company with country UK for each winner). Starter keys return a short sample (up to 5 results, last 14 days); paid keys allow up to 50 results and 90 days.
